title: Why am I Presbyterian
description: Many in the reformed camp seemed to be either Baptist or Presbyterian. This is article is to show my view in Reformed Theology.

content.title: Why am I Presbyterian
content.htmlContent: There is an endless debate on covenant membership. Who is a part of the covenant and who is not? This question is a good question to cause you to search the scriptures for answers. I would start from Genesis and end in Revelation.

title: Help with System Design Interviews
description: System design study focuses on understanding user requirements, creating system architecture and developing a plan for implementation.

content.title: Preparation for the Interview
content.htmlContent: System design aims to build systems that are reliable, effective, and maintainable. Reliable systems handle faults, failures, and errors. Effective systems meet all user needs and business requirements. Maintainable systems are flexible and easy to scale up or down.
